About.p1: I was born and raised in Nigeria, where I developed a deep appreciation for community, hard work, and the belief that where you come from does not determine where you can go.
About.p2: In 2019, my family and I moved to Canada, settling first in the Greater Toronto Area. Two years later, my wife was presented with a career opportunity in Ottawa. As we explored the city and considered where we wanted to raise our children and build our future, the answer became clear: Ward 22.
About.p3: We chose this community deliberately — not by default.
About.p4: Professionally, I work in finance and hold an Executive MBA from the Ivey Business School. My career has taught me how to analyze complex problems, plan for the long term, and make responsible decisions that stand up to scrutiny.
About.p5: But more than any credential, I am a husband, a father, and a neighbour. Our children are growing up here. Our friendships are here. Our future is here.
About.p6: Like so many families, we came to Canada to build a life filled with opportunity, purpose, and possibility. We found those opportunities here, and in Ward 22, we found something even more important — a place to call home.
About.p7: Ward 22 is where we live, work, and raise our families. It deserves a councillor who treats it like home — because it is.
About.quote_home: "Steady attention, honest listening, and follow-through on the things that actually matter."
About.quote_page: "Canada gave our family an opportunity. Ward 22 gave us home."

Running.title: Why I'm Running
Running.subtitle: This wasn't a decision made at a desk. It came from living here.
Running.name: Muyiwa Ojo
Running.p1: I am Muyiwa Ojo — a husband, father of two, and proud Ward 22 resident who calls this community home with my wife and our two children.
Running.p2: Like many of you, we chose Ward 22 because of what it promised: safe streets, strong schools, and a place where families could put down roots and thrive. In many ways, it has delivered on that promise.
Running.p3: Over the years, I have also seen where we can do better.
Running.p4: As our community grows, young families need more parks, programs, and spaces where children can learn, play, and thrive. Residents spend too much time commuting when better transit connections could make the journey shorter and less stressful. And our ward is expanding faster than some of the infrastructure and services needed to support it.
Running.p5: My professional background has given me the tools to analyse problems, plan for the long term, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. But my decision to run wasn't made at a desk. It came from living here.
Running.p6: It came from conversations with neighbours. From seeing families navigate crowded parks and growing communities. From hearing residents talk about traffic, housing, local services, and the future they want for Ward 22.
Running.p7: Those conversations led me to file my nomination on May 1, 2026.
Running.quote: "I am not running because I have all the answers. I am running because I believe the best solutions come from the people who live here."
Running.p8: My role is to listen, bring people together, and ensure residents have a strong voice at City Hall.
Running.p9: Since filing my nomination, I have spent my time where it matters most — at your doors, on your streets, and in your neighbourhoods, listening to your concerns, ideas, and aspirations for our community.
Running.p10: I am not a career politician. I am a neighbour who cares deeply about Ward 22 and its future. Ward 22 deserves a councillor who is present, practical, accountable, and committed to serving every resident.
Running.p11: This community is our home. Together, we can build a Ward 22 that keeps pace with growth, protects what makes our neighbourhood special, and creates real opportunities for every family who calls it home.

Testimonials.title: Voices from Across the Ward.
Testimonials.quote1: Muyiwa shows up, listens, and follows through. That's exactly what Ward 22 needs at the council table.
Testimonials.quote2: He's focused on the practical things — the services, the streets, the everyday issues that too often get ignored.
Testimonials.quote3: A steady, thoughtful voice. Muyiwa understands that good government is in the details.
